validate keeps only valid dict events, rejects bool deltas, strips SKU validity checks, returns fresh sku/delta dicts, and does not mutate input.
normalize returns fresh ordered records using stripped Unicode casefolded SKUs and unchanged deltas.
aggregate sums all normalized SKU deltas, retains zero totals, and does not mutate records.
select returns a fresh mapping containing all and only nonzero balances, including negatives.
render sorts SKUs lexicographically and emits newline-joined sku=integer rows with no trailing newline.
